# analyze_naneinf_negatives reference scores.
#
# Regenerated after Diet Cola farming: a non-Negative copy joker met after the
# first Diet Cola is worth one more cola (sell the copy joker you hold, buy the
# next), per kind, until a Negative one of that kind turns up. A tag then spends
# 90% of the stock, rounded down.
#
# Scores rose sharply -- 22 of 32 up, 9 unchanged, 1 down, +25% overall. The one
# that fell is expected, not a fault: more colas means wider windows, which keep
# more Uncommons, which drains the pool faster and shifts every later draw.
#
# Generated on pocl. pocl and the 5080 agreed on all 32 before these model
# changes, so it remains a cross-platform baseline.
